instruction: Play content from Amazon Prime Video that you purchased by loading the video file in VLC media player.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Amazon Prime Video uses DRM protection (Widevine/PlayReady) for all content, including purchased titles. VLC does not support these DRM systems and cannot decrypt or play Prime Video content.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible due to DRM protection on Amazon Prime Video content
VLC media player cannot decrypt Widevine/PlayReady DRM systems used by Prime Video
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for tasks that cannot be completed
Metadata provides clear technical explanation for why the task is impossible
No verification logic is needed since the task has no valid completion state
